steps.name: Wait for language screen
Check language screen is visible
Tap Get started on language screen
Check title is English 'Welcome to L2B'
Wait for onboarding slide 1
Tap Next on onboarding
Wait for onboarding slide 2
Check onboarding is on slide 2
Tap Get started on onboarding slide 2
Check onboarding is on slide 2
Wait for Sign up screen
Enter mobile number
Hide keyboard if shown
Accept terms and privacy checkbox
Read Get OTP enabled on the clickable outer View
Tap Get OTP
Wait for OTP screen
Check 'Verify your OTP' is visible
Check 'Verify your OTP' is visible
Count OTP EditText nodes
Focus the OTP EditText
Press digit keys without replacing the field
Wait for Quick Booking landing
